articles.title: Valkyries Bring the Trophy Home With a Bay Area Parade
articles.summary: The Golden State Valkyries celebrated their WNBA title with a parade from Oakland to San Francisco on Wednesday.

articles.title: NASA's Swift Telescope Falls to Earth After 22 Years
articles.summary: NASA's Swift space telescope fell back to Earth on Wednesday after 22 years in orbit, following a failed rescue attempt.

articles.title: As Budgets Tighten, More People Are Dusting Off Their Library Cards
articles.summary: As budgets tighten, more Americans are turning to libraries for free books, movies, classes and more.
